modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: Console-script bootstrap: loads environment settings, creates the repository, initializes the SQLite schema, and reports readiness.

modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Defines immutable Settings and translates MINISVC_DB and MINISVC_READONLY environment values into settings.

modules.name: minisvc.models
modules.purpose: Defines the Order data model with order_id, customer, and total_cents fields.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: SQLite-backed OrderRepository for schema creation, inserting orders, and loading one order.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Constructs order event dictionaries; it does not persist audit records.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: Registers POST and GET order routes on an HTTP adapter and binds them to handlers.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Converts API payloads to Orders, saves or retrieves them through the repository, and returns response dictionaries with event data.

key_functions.description: Loads environment settings, instantiates OrderRepository, calls init_schema, prints readiness, and returns 0; argv is unused.
Reads MINISVC_DB with orders.sqlite as the default and treats MINISVC_READONLY as true only when exactly 1.
Binds POST /orders to create_order and GET /orders/<order_id> to get_order using lambdas that capture the repository.
Builds an Order from required payload keys, converts total_cents with int(), saves it, and returns a created response plus an in-memory event.
Loads an order, returns missing when absent, otherwise serializes __dict__ and adds an in-memory read event.
Creates the orders table if needed; no audit table is created.
Inserts an order using parameterized SQL and commits through the sqlite3 connection context manager.
Selects one order by order_id and reconstructs an Order from the row, or returns None.
Returns a dictionary containing event type, action, order_id, and total_cents; it has no storage side effect.

runtime_flows.name: CLI startup
steps: The installed minisvc console script calls minisvc.cli:main.
load_settings returns database_path and readonly settings.
main calls OrderRepository.init_schema, creating the SQLite orders table if absent.
main prints the database path and returns 0.

runtime_flows.name: HTTP create-order
steps: The HTTP adapter dispatches POST /orders to the captured create_order handler.
create_order reads order_id, customer, and total_cents from the payload and constructs an Order.
OrderRepository.save inserts the order into SQLite.
create_order calls order_event to construct an in-memory created event.
The handler returns status, order_id, and the event dictionary; no audit row is written.
